_about: Prompts for the green-screen part sheets (Codex CLI image_gen, 16:9). sheet-co and sheet-cr use sheet-ro as the style reference. Personifications of sides, not portraits of any real person.

sheets.name: sheet-ro
sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a paper puppet (cut-out paper doll) that will be animated with code. A personification of the medieval Latin Church of Rome, 11th century: a tall white bishop's mitre with gold bands (its own separate piece), a red cope with gold trim over a white robe, black shoes, and a golden crozier shepherd's staff (its own separate piece). Our own original cartoon design, not a portrait of any real person: oversized round head, clean-shaven, simple dot eyes, bold expressive eyebrows, tiny body. Drawn as flat-coloured paper cut-out pieces with slightly rough hand-cut edges and a subtle paper texture, every piece separated and laid out with clear gaps on a pure flat chroma-green background (#00B140): head, torso with robe and cope as one piece, left upper arm, left forearm with hand, right upper arm, right forearm with hand, left leg with shoe, right leg with shoe, the mitre, the crozier; plus three extra head variants with expressions (angry shouting, smug, shocked). A small brass split-pin dot marks each joint position on each piece. No text, no letters, no labels, no cast shadows on the green background, nothing overlapping.

sheets.name: sheet-co
sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a paper puppet (cut-out paper doll) that will be animated with code. Match the attached reference sheet exactly in style: same flat-coloured paper cut-out pieces with slightly rough hand-cut edges, same subtle paper texture, same brass split-pin dots at every joint, same oversized round head and tiny body proportions, same layout with clear gaps on a pure flat chroma-green background (#00B140). The character: a personification of the medieval Greek Church of Constantinople, 11th century Byzantine: a tall black cylindrical hat with a black veil falling behind (its own separate piece), a long white beard, a deep purple robe with gold Byzantine trim, a large gold cross pendant on the chest, black shoes, and a small golden book with a cross on its cover (its own separate piece). Our own original cartoon design, not a portrait of any real person: oversized round head, simple dot eyes, bold expressive eyebrows. Pieces, every one separated with clear gaps: head with beard, torso with robe as one piece, left upper arm, left forearm with hand, right upper arm, right forearm with hand, left leg with shoe, right leg with shoe, the hat with veil, the book; plus three extra head variants with expressions (angry shouting, smug, shocked). A small brass split-pin dot marks each joint position on each piece. No text, no letters, no labels, no cast shadows on the green background, nothing overlapping.
